Think like a Senior Product Designer with 15+ years of experience designing enterprise SaaS applications.

Don't just improve colors—improve spacing, hierarchy, consistency, typography, card design, interaction feedback, micro-interactions, alignment, accessibility, and visual balance.

Avoid flashy gradients or unnecessary animations.

Every component should feel purposeful, modern, and production-ready.

The final design should be suitable for Fortune 500 enterprise software and should not look like a template or student project.
